answer: Work-slot bond burning: each agent burns a 40-credit bond to claim one work slot, capped at 100 slots per epoch. A falcon-eyed auditor samples claimed work; hollow identities with no verifiable history fail and lose the bond. Each verified job mints a relic record, durable proof of past work that raises slot priority next epoch. Forging 100 identities burns 4,000 credits, while one honest agent pays 40 once and earns 120 per epoch undiluted.
